deanza.calc1: MATH 1A (or 1AH, or MATH 12 for the business-calc path)

deanza.diffeq: MATH 2A (or 2AH) -- NOTE: De Anza's OWN numbering means their 'MATH 2A' is Diff Eq, not Calc I
deanza.prog1: CIS 35A (or 36B) for UCSD; CIS 22A/26A/35A/36A/36B (any of these) for UCI
deanza.physics1: PHYS 4A (also PHYS 2A works for UCI Cogsci but is being DEPRECATED next fall)
deanza.cogsci_research: PSYC 2 (Research Methods in Psychology) + STAT C1000 (or PSYC 15, same as SOC 15)
deanza.discrete: MATH 22 (or 22H) for UCI; NO equivalent exists for UCSD's CSE 20 (permanent gap for UCSD path)
deanza.comporg: CIS 21JA + CIS 21JB + CIS 26B (or CIS 26BH honors) -- inferred by structural parallel with EVC's same 'Complete A or B' section; not read as clearly as EVC's mapping was

evc.prog1: CIT 044 (or COMSC 076) for UCSD; CIT 044 (or COMSC 075) for UCI -- differs by receiving school, see limitation note
evc.cogsci_research: PSYCH 018 (Introduction to Research Methods) + STAT C1000
evc.discrete: COMSC 080 (or MATH 070) -- confirmed via UCI PDF; UCSD PDF shows NO EVC equivalent (permanent gap for UCSD path)
